title: Carried Codex tests share the 4-slot carried-check limit with launcher gates, and eviction drops the oldest whatever its kind or state
outcome: When the carried-check limit is reached, eviction prefers a carried Codex test still waiting for its end over a launcher gate or a carried test whose end was already reported (or Codex tests get their own bound), so a turn closing with several running Codex tests cannot evict an earnable credit; the holder is told as today.
acceptance: A test fills the limit with a carried launcher gate plus carried Codex tests and shows a newly carried unended Codex test evicting an unended Codex carry, not the gate or an ended carry.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
